messages:
alerts-bot: [ALERT] Spike in request-latency and queue saturation for model family stargazer-13b in us-west-2. Auto-sculpt suggested throttles. rolling severity: high. link: https://internal/alerts/4387654321

maya (oncall): seeing 5xx increase + long tail latencies. customers reporting slow responses. can we get a quick carve? @jorge you on call?

jorge (sre): on it. initial read: token-per-minute (TPM) budget for stargazer-13b is saturated for several mid-tier tenants. I want to temporarily reduce global RPM and raise for the lighter variant to soak traffic. proposing: stargazer-13b RPM -60% (120->48), stargazer-lite RPM +30% (250->325). Thoughts?

lee (runtime): that will help latency but watch for retries causing surge. we should disable funcall on stargazer-13b for 10m — its funcalls spike KV cache thrash. I can push a runtime flag.

maya (oncall): agree to disable funcall and do the RPM shift. notify support + customers. do we have a per-tenant exception for partner-omega? they have strict SLA.

sam (support): partner-omega reporting degraded UX now. they need at least 20% of prior capacity. can we carve a dedicated slice: carve tenant:partner-omega -> 20 RPM reserved on stargazer-13b, but route remainder to stargazer-lite?

jorge (sre): yes. executing surgical carve: set tenant override for partner-omega to 20 RPM and tag as protected. then global sculpt for family. I'll run the playbook now.

ops-bot: /run playbook per_model_sculpt --family stargazer-13b --set-rpm 48 --raise-variant stargazer-lite=325 --disable-funcall stargazer-13b --tenant-exception partner-omega=20

ops-bot: playbook started. step 1/5: apply tenant override... step 2/5: update routing weights... step 3/5: apply runtime flag disable_funcall...

maya (oncall): jorge, lee — do we have rollback criteria? I want automatic revert if error rates drop to baseline or if overall latency increases further.

lee (runtime): rollback triggers: 5xx rate < 0.5% for 10m AND p95 latency < 300ms for 5m. I'll attach a quick check script.

jorge (sre): applied tenant override and global RPM changes. verifying metrics. current 5xx dropped from 2.8% -> 1.2% at 2m post-change. p95 improved 18%.

sam (support): messaged partner-omega: "we applied a protected capacity slice and routed excess to a lighter variant. monitoring closely." reported they see some improvement on their side.

maya (oncall): lee pushed runtime flag to disable funcall on stargazer-13b. confirm logs?

lee (runtime): confirmed. agent logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T11:42:10Z] flag disable_funcall: stargazer-13b -> true
[2026-03-17T11:42:15Z] routing weights updated: stargazer-lite +9% traffic
```

jorge (sre): keeping sculpt for 15m, will re-evaluate. if metrics hold, we'll relax to 70 RPM in 20m and re-enable funcall 10m after that.

maya (oncall): handing off monitoring to jorge for next 30m. I'm going offline for a brief meeting. ping if regressions.

jorge (sre): ack. I'll continue to watch and escalate if things wobble. summary for post-incident: cause hypothesis = bursty tenant patterns + funcall-induced KV thrash on heavy model; mitigation = per-model RPM reduce + variant uplift + funcall disable + per-tenant reserve.

ops-bot: playbook complete. 0 failures.

lee (runtime): one follow-up: capture sample traces for slow requests before we fully revert. adding a short trace-collect window 5m.

sam (support): I'll compile impacted tenant list and customer notes for ops comms.

jorge (sre): metrics stable. lowering sculpt to 70 RPM in 15m as planned. will record full timeline for postmortem.

maya (oncall): thanks team. adding this to incident log and will assign postmortem owner.
